title: nginx/1.24.0 Web Server Exposed
description: nginx/1.24.0 on Ubuntu serving cyberian-defenses.com at 76.13.46.223. Version disclosure enables targeted vuln matching.
risks: Server version disclosure aids attacker reconnaissance and targeted exploit selection.
attack_vectors: Search nginx 1.24.0 CVEs; test for misconfigurations like directory listing, path traversal, or status page exposure.
proof_of_existence: HTTP headers revealed Server: nginx/1.24.0, X-Powered-By indicators, Ubuntu backend. Confirmed via passive recon cycle 1.
remediation: Hide server version tokens in nginx config; apply server_tokens off.

title: Missing DNSSEC Configuration
description: No DNSSEC RRSIG/DNSKEY records found for cyberian-defenses.com. DNS responses are not cryptographically signed.
risks: DNS spoofing/cache poisoning attacks could redirect users to malicious sites.
attack_vectors: Perform DNS cache poisoning or MITM to inject false DNS records if network position allows.
proof_of_existence: DNS query for DNSKEY returned no records. DNSSEC not configured per passive recon.
remediation: Enable DNSSEC signing on the domain via registrar/DNS provider.

title: Missing CAA DNS Record
description: No CAA record found. Any CA could issue certificates for the domain without restriction.
risks: Unauthorized certificate issuance possible if a CA is compromised or social-engineered.
attack_vectors: Request TLS certificate from any CA for the domain; no DNS-level restriction prevents rogue issuance.
proof_of_existence: CAA query returned no records. No certificate authority authorization restrictions in place.
remediation: Add CAA records restricting certificate issuance to authorized CAs only.

title: Azure CDN/Front Door Detected
description: Azure edge domain detected (cyberian-defenses.azureedge.net). Origin server may be directly accessible at 76.13.46.223.
risks: If CDN/WAF bypass is possible, direct origin access at 76.13.46.223 may bypass protections.
attack_vectors: Attempt direct origin access via IP 76.13.46.223 with Host header injection to bypass CDN/WAF rules.
proof_of_existence: azureedge.net domain referenced in DNS/infra. Tool blocked from probing it as out of scope, but presence confirmed.
remediation: Restrict origin server to only accept traffic from Azure CDN IP ranges; configure firewall rules.

title: Third-Party Form Handler (Formspree)
description: Formspree integration detected for form handling. Form data is sent to third-party service.
risks: Sensitive form data transits third-party infrastructure; potential data exposure or supply chain risk.
attack_vectors: Analyze form endpoints for data leakage; test for XSS via form fields that may be reflected in Formspree dashboard.
poc: Identified via web tech fingerprinting in page source
proof_of_existence: Tailwind CSS, Calendly, and Formspree detected in page source during tech fingerprinting.
remediation: Review third-party data handling policies; implement CSP to restrict outbound form submissions.

title: Key Personnel Identified — Ahmed Chiboub
description: Ahmed Chiboub identified as associated with cyberian-defenses.com via WHOIS/OSINT data.
risks: Credential harvesting, phishing, or social engineering targeting this individual possible.
attack_vectors: Search breach databases for credentials; craft targeted phishing using LinkedIn/GitHub profile data.
poc: WHOIS lookup and web content analysis revealed name association
proof_of_existence: WHOIS and site content reference Ahmed Chiboub as key person associated with the domain.
remediation: Enforce MFA on all accounts; monitor for credential leaks in breach databases.

title: No IPv6 Support Configured
description: No AAAA records found for cyberian-defenses.com. IPv6 connectivity not available.
risks: No direct risk; may limit attack surface but also indicates incomplete modern network config.
attack_vectors: N/A — informational. IPv4-only may simplify some scanning but limits reachability.
proof_of_existence: AAAA query returned no records. Domain is IPv4-only.
remediation: Consider adding IPv6 support with equivalent security controls as IPv4.

title: CSP allows unsafe-inline in script-src
description: Content-Security-Policy includes 'unsafe-inline' in script-src directive, bypassing XSS mitigations.
risks: Reflected/stored XSS could execute despite CSP, enabling session theft and credential harvesting.
attack_vectors: Find any reflected or stored input on the site (blog comments, forms, URL params) and inject inline JS payloads.
proof_of_existence: CSP header observed with script-src containing 'unsafe-inline' directive. Also connect-src and form-action allow https://formspree.io...
remediation: Remove 'unsafe-inline' from script-src; use nonces or hashes for inline scripts.

title: Catch-all vhost on HTTPS returns 200 for all Host headers
description: All 128 tested virtual host names return HTTP 200 on port 443, indicating catch-all nginx config.
risks: Host header injection, cache poisoning, or routing bypass may be possible depending on backend behavior.
attack_vectors: Send requests with arbitrary Host headers; test if different content is served or if backend trusts Host for redirects/links.
proof_of_existence: Port 443: 128 vhost names tested → all returned 200. Port 80: 128 vhost names tested → all returned 404...
remediation: Configure nginx default_server to return 444 or 403; validate Host header against known domains.

title: SSH exposed on port 22 with known username
description: SSH service open on port 22. Username ahmed.chiboub identified from website meta-author tag.
risks: Credential brute-force or password guessing could yield shell access to the server.
attack_vectors: Attempt SSH brute-force with common passwords and username ahmed.chiboub; check for key-based auth only.
proof_of_existence: Port 22 open (SSH). Key person Ahmed Chiboub identified with email ahmed.chiboub@cyberian-defenses.com from meta-author tag...
remediation: Enforce key-based auth only, disable password auth, implement fail2ban, restrict SSH to known IPs.

title: Third-party form handler Formspree in CSP
description: CSP connect-src and form-action allow https://formspree.io, a third-party form processing service.
risks: Form data is sent to third-party; if Formspree is compromised or token leaked, user data could be harvested.
attack_vectors: Intercept form submissions; test if Formspree endpoint IDs are predictable or if CSRF can submit to attacker's Formspree.
poc: Review HTML source for Formspree form action URLs and analyze token security.
proof_of_existence: CSP header includes connect-src and form-action directives allowing https://formspree.io...
remediation: Validate Formspree integration; ensure CSRF tokens on forms; consider self-hosted form handler.

title: Missing DNSSEC, CAA, and IPv6 records
description: DNS zone lacks DNSSEC, CAA records, and AAAA records. SystemDNS used (no managed DNS provider).
risks: DNS spoofing possible without DNSSEC; unauthorized CA can issue certs without CAA; no IPv6 connectivity.
attack_vectors: DNS cache poisoning; request fraudulent TLS certificates without CAA restriction; DNS hijacking via registrar.
poc: dig DNSKEY cyberian-defenses.com; dig CAA cyberian-defenses.com; dig AAAA cyberian-defenses.com
proof_of_existence: DNSSEC, CAA, and IPv6 (AAAA) records all absent per DNS analysis results...
remediation: Enable DNSSEC; add CAA records restricting CA issuance; deploy IPv6 if applicable.

title: High TCP ports unscanned — potential hidden services
description: TCP port scan for ports 1001-65535 timed out. Services on non-standard ports remain undetected.
risks: Databases, admin panels, or dev services on high ports could be accessible to attackers.
proof_of_existence: High TCP ports (1001–65535): Scan timed out — critical gap noted in Lisa report...
remediation: Complete high-port scan with faster timing; close unnecessary ports via firewall.

title: Azure CDN subdomain discovered but unvalidated
description: Subdomain cyberian-defenses.azureedge.net identified as Azure CDN endpoint for the target.
risks: If CDN endpoint is decommissioned but CNAME remains, subdomain takeover possible.
attack_vectors: Check if Azure CDN endpoint is active or available for re-registration; verify CNAME chain.
proof_of_existence: Subdomain cyberian-defenses.azureedge.net discovered during recon but blocked from further testing due to scope restriction...
remediation: Verify CDN endpoint is active; remove stale CNAME records; consider adding to scope for assessment.

title: Blog page detected at /blog/
description: HTTP enumeration found /blog/ path and /robots.txt on the target.
risks: Blog may have comment forms, search functionality, or CMS with exploitable vulnerabilities.
attack_vectors: Enumerate blog platform; test for SQLi, XSS in comments/search; check robots.txt for hidden paths.
proof_of_existence: http-enum results: /blog/ — Blog page detected, /robots.txt — Robots file present...
remediation: Ensure blog CMS is patched; validate all input; restrict robots.txt from exposing sensitive paths.

title: SSH password authentication enabled
description: OpenSSH 9.6p1 accepts password authentication, enabling brute-force attacks.
risks: Credential brute-force could yield shell access to server.
attack_vectors: Use hydra or medusa with username lists against SSH service.
proof_of_existence: Lisa cycle 2 reported SSH password authentication enabled. OpenSSH 9.6p1 on port 22.
remediation: Disable password authentication in sshd_config, use key-based auth only.

title: SSH weak MAC algorithm hmac-sha1 supported
description: SSH server supports hmac-sha1, a weak MAC algorithm vulnerable to theoretical attacks.
risks: Weakened integrity protection on SSH sessions under specific conditions.
attack_vectors: Force negotiated MAC to hmac-sha1 during session establishment.
proof_of_existence: Lisa cycle 2 reported hmac-sha1 in supported MAC algorithms list.
remediation: Remove hmac-sha1 from MACs in sshd_config, use hmac-sha2-512 only.

title: nginx version disclosure
description: nginx 1.24.0 version exposed in HTTP headers and error pages.
risks: Attacker can match version against CVE database for targeted exploits.
attack_vectors: Send HTTP request and inspect Server header or error page footer.
proof_of_existence: Lisa reported Server: nginx/1.24.0 (Ubuntu) in HTTP response headers.
remediation: Set server_tokens off in nginx config.

title: CSP unsafe-inline directive weakens XSS protection
description: Content-Security-Policy header includes unsafe-inline, allowing inline script execution.
risks: XSS vulnerabilities can be exploited without nonce/hash bypass required.
attack_vectors: If XSS found, inject inline script tags directly without CSP bypass needed.
proof_of_existence: Lisa cycle 1 and 2 reported CSP with unsafe-inline in script-src or default-src.
remediation: Remove unsafe-inline, use nonces or hashes for inline scripts.

title: Email and author metadata exposed
description: Page metadata reveals ahmed.chiboub@cyberian-defenses.com as author/contact.
risks: Enables targeted phishing and OSINT for social engineering attacks.
attack_vectors: Use email for spear-phishing campaigns or credential stuffing.
proof_of_existence: Lisa reported email ahmed.chiboub@cyberian-defenses.com and author Ahmed Chiboub in page metadata.
remediation: Remove personal email from public-facing metadata, use generic contact.

title: External form service dependency formspree.io
description: Contact form submits to formspree.io external service, potentially exposing user data.
risks: Form data routed through third-party; supply-chain risk if formspree compromised.
attack_vectors: Assess formspree.io endpoint for IDOR, data leakage, or SSRF.
proof_of_existence: Lisa reported formspree.io as form service in web technology analysis.
remediation: Assess formspree.io data handling; consider self-hosted form processor.

title: robots.txt exists but contents not analyzed
description: /robots.txt path exists on web server but contents have not been retrieved.
risks: May expose hidden directories or admin paths intended for crawler exclusion.
attack_vectors: Retrieve and parse robots.txt for Disallow entries to find hidden paths.
proof_of_existence: Lisa cycle 1 found /robots.txt path but contents not retrieved in cycle 1 or 2.
remediation: Ensure robots.txt does not expose sensitive paths unnecessarily.

title: Vhost catch-all on port 443
description: Port 443 returns default page for arbitrary Host headers, indicating catch-all vhost config.
risks: May allow vhost enumeration or Host header injection attacks.
attack_vectors: Send requests with various Host headers to enumerate virtual hosts.
proof_of_existence: Lisa cycle 1 detected vhost catch-all behavior on 443. Not fully investigated.
remediation: Configure nginx to reject unknown Host headers with 444 or 421.

title: CVE-2024-6387 regreSSHion RCE — OpenSSH 9.6p1 in affected range
description: OpenSSH 9.6p1 falls within CVE-2024-6387 affected range (8.5p1–9.7p1). Race condition in signal handler allows unauthenticated RCE. Ubuntu backport patch status unverified.
risks: Unauthenticated remote code execution could lead to full server compromise and data breach.
attack_vectors: Exploit race condition in OpenSSH sshd signal handler by repeatedly connecting and timing signal delivery during grace period. Requires ~10K attempts on average.
poc: nmap -sV -p22 cyberian-defenses.com confirmed OpenSSH 9.6p1 Ubuntu 3; version falls in CVE-2024-6387 range
proof_of_existence: OpenSSH 9.6p1 confirmed via nmap banner grab. CVE-2024-6387 affects 8.5p1<=OpenSSH<=9.7p1. Ubuntu 3 backport patch status could not be verified — may be patched...
remediation: Patch OpenSSH to 9.8p1+ or apply Ubuntu security update for CVE-2024-6387 immediately.

title: CSP unsafe-inline allows XSS exploitation without nonce bypass
description: Content-Security-Policy includes unsafe-inline in both script-src and style-src directives, allowing inline script execution.
risks: Any reflected or stored XSS vulnerability can be directly exploited without needing to bypass CSP nonce restrictions.
attack_vectors: Identify any user input reflected on blog pages or contact form; inject inline JavaScript payload — CSP permits execution due to unsafe-inline.
poc: curl -sk https://cyberian-defenses.com | grep -i content-security-policy — shows unsafe-inline in script-src and style-src
proof_of_existence: CSP header: script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' cdn.tailwindcss.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' cdn.tailwindcss.com — unsafe-inline present in both directives...
remediation: Replace unsafe-inline with nonce-based or hash-based CSP directives for script-src and style-src.

title: SSH password authentication enabled
description: SSH service accepts password-based authentication in addition to public key auth.
risks: Enables credential brute-force and credential stuffing attacks against SSH service.
attack_vectors: Enumerate valid usernames (e.g., ahmed.chiboub@cyberian-defenses.com found), then attempt password spraying or brute-force via sshpass/hydra.
poc: nmap --script ssh-auth-methods -p22 cyberian-defenses.com — shows password auth enabled
proof_of_existence: SSH auth methods: publickey, password — password method confirmed enabled via nmap ssh-auth-methods script...
remediation: Disable password authentication in sshd_config; enforce key-based authentication only.

title: .git directory exists on web server (HTTP 403)
description: /.git/HEAD and /.git/config return HTTP 403, indicating git repository exists on web root but directory listing is blocked.
risks: If bypassed via alternate paths (.git/logs/HEAD, .git/index), source code and commit history could be exposed.
attack_vectors: Attempt encoded paths (%2e%2e/.git), alternate git files (/index.html/.git/HEAD), or double-encoding to bypass nginx access rules.
proof_of_existence: GET /.git/HEAD → 403 (162 bytes); GET /.git/config → 403 (162 bytes) — both return 403 indicating files exist but access blocked...
remediation: Remove .git directory from web root entirely; add nginx location block denying all .git paths.

title: .env file exists on web server (HTTP 403)
description: /.env returns HTTP 403, indicating environment configuration file exists on web root but direct access is blocked.
risks: If bypassed, could expose database credentials, API keys, and application secrets.
attack_vectors: Attempt path traversal, double-encoding, or alternate file extensions to bypass nginx access controls.
proof_of_existence: GET /.env → 403 (162 bytes) — file exists but access blocked by nginx configuration...
remediation: Remove .env file from web root; store secrets outside web-accessible directories.

title: Weak HMAC-SHA1 MAC algorithm supported by SSH
description: SSH service supports hmac-sha1 MAC algorithm which has known cryptographic weaknesses compared to SHA-2 variants.
risks: Enables potential MAC downgrade attacks; SHA-1 has known collision vulnerabilities.
attack_vectors: Force MAC algorithm negotiation to hmac-sha1 during SSH handshake; leverage for traffic integrity attacks.
poc: nmap --script ssh2-enum-algos -p22 cyberian-defenses.com — shows hmac-sha1 in MACs list
proof_of_existence: SSH MAC algorithms include: umac-64-etm@openssh.com, hmac-sha1-etm@openssh.com, hmac-sha1 — hmac-sha1 weak algorithm present...
remediation: Remove hmac-sha1 from MACs in sshd_config; enforce only SHA-2 based algorithms.

title: nginx version disclosure in HTTP headers
description: nginx version 1.24.0 disclosed in Server HTTP response header and error pages.
risks: Aids attackers in targeting specific CVEs for known nginx versions.
attack_vectors: Passively read Server header to identify exact version; cross-reference with CVE databases.
poc: curl -skI https://cyberian-defenses.com | grep Server — shows nginx/1.24.0
proof_of_existence: Server: nginx/1.24.0 (Ubuntu) — version disclosed in HTTP response header...
remediation: Set server_tokens off in nginx configuration to suppress version information.

title: Deprecated X-XSS-Protection header present
description: X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block header is deprecated and can introduce vulnerabilities in modern browsers.
risks: Minimal — modern browsers ignore this header, but its presence suggests outdated security configuration practices.
attack_vectors: Not directly exploitable; informational concern only.
proof_of_existence: X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block — deprecated header present in HTTP response...
remediation: Remove X-XSS-Protection header; rely on CSP for XSS prevention.

title: CVE-2024-6387 regreSSHion RCE on OpenSSH 9.6p1
description: OpenSSH 9.6p1 is in CVE-2024-6387 affected range. RCE via signal handler race condition in sshd. Ubuntu backport patch status unverified.
risks: Unauthenticated remote code execution as root if unpatched.
attack_vectors: Exploit race condition in sshd signal handler during authentication. Requires ~10k attempts. Affects glibc-based Linux with ASLR.
poc: nmap -sV -p22 cyberian-defenses.com (version detection only; no exploit attempted)
proof_of_existence: Nmap: OpenSSH 9.6p1 Ubuntu on port 22. CVE-2024-6387 affects 8.5p1<=9.7p1. Ubuntu backport patch unverified — theoretical only.
remediation: Patch OpenSSH to latest version or verify Ubuntu security backport applied.

title: CSP unsafe-inline directive enables XSS exploitation
description: Content-Security-Policy includes 'unsafe-inline' for scripts, allowing inline script execution if XSS injection point exists.
risks: Any reflected/stored XSS becomes directly exploitable without nonce bypass needed.
attack_vectors: Find injection point in blog pages or form parameters, inject <script> tag — CSP will not block execution.
proof_of_existence: CSP header: script-src includes 'unsafe-inline'. Blog pages (/blog/) and formspree.io form are potential injection vectors untested.
remediation: Remove unsafe-inline from CSP; use nonces or hashes for script execution.

title: SSH password authentication enabled
description: SSH accepts password-based authentication, enabling brute-force and credential stuffing attacks.
risks: Account compromise via password guessing, credential stuffing, or spray attacks.
attack_vectors: Brute-force SSH passwords using tools like hydra or medusa against known usernames (ahmed.chiboub).
proof_of_existence: SSH auth methods scan: password authentication enabled alongside publickey.
remediation: Disable SSH password authentication; enforce key-based auth only.

title: .git and .env files present in web root (403 blocked)
description: /.git and /.env return HTTP 403, confirming files exist in web root but are access-restricted by nginx.
risks: Source code or environment variable disclosure if nginx config changes or bypass found.
attack_vectors: Try encoded paths (%2e%2e%2fgit), alternate git files (.git/logs/HEAD, .git/index, .git/HEAD), path traversal, or nginx misconfig bypass.
proof_of_existence: HTTP 403 for /.git and /.env — files exist but blocked. Bypass attempts not completed due to environmental constraints.
remediation: Remove .git and .env from web root entirely; do not rely on nginx access rules.

title: Weak SSH MAC algorithm hmac-sha1 enabled
description: SSH server accepts hmac-sha1 MAC algorithm, which is considered cryptographically weak.
risks: Potential MAC forgery or downgrade attack in MITM scenarios.
attack_vectors: Force weak MAC negotiation in MITM position to weaken connection integrity.
proof_of_existence: SSH MAC algorithms include hmac-sha1 alongside stronger options like hmac-sha2-256.
remediation: Remove hmac-sha1 from SSH MAC algorithm list; use hmac-sha2-256/512 only.

title: nginx server_tokens disclosure
description: nginx exposes version number (1.24.0) in HTTP response headers, aiding attacker reconnaissance.
risks: Attackers can target known nginx version-specific vulnerabilities.
attack_vectors: Use version info to search for applicable CVEs and tailor exploits.
proof_of_existence: Server: nginx/1.24.0 in HTTP response headers.
remediation: Set server_tokens off in nginx configuration.

title: Deprecated X-XSS-Protection header present
description: X-XSS-Protection header is deprecated and can introduce vulnerabilities in modern browsers.
risks: Minimal — header ignored by modern browsers but signals outdated security config.
attack_vectors: No direct exploitation; informational finding.
proof_of_existence: X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block present in response headers.
remediation: Remove X-XSS-Protection header; rely on CSP for XSS mitigation.

title: CVE-2024-6387 regreSSHion RCE on OpenSSH 9.6p1
description: OpenSSH 9.6p1 is in CVE-2024-6387 affected range (<9.8). Ubuntu backport suffix '3' may include patch. Unverified.
risks: Unauthenticated RCE via SSH race condition if backport does not patch CVE-2024-6387.
attack_vectors: Exploit race condition in sshd signal handler to achieve RCE. Requires timing analysis and multiple connection attempts.
proof_of_existence: SSH banner: SSH-2.0-OpenSSH_9.6p1 Ubuntu-3ubuntu1. Version 9.6p1 is within CVE-2024-6387 affected range. Ubuntu backport patch status not verified...
remediation: Patch OpenSSH to 9.8+ or apply Ubuntu security update for CVE-2024-6387.

title: CSP allows unsafe-inline scripts
description: Content-Security-Policy includes 'unsafe-inline' in script-src directive, allowing inline script execution.
risks: Any reflected XSS vulnerability becomes directly exploitable without nonce bypass needed.
attack_vectors: Inject inline <script> tags via any reflected input parameter. CSP will not block execution.
proof_of_existence: CSP header contains: script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' cdn.tailwindcss.com. unsafe-inline present in script-src directive...
remediation: Remove unsafe-inline from CSP; use nonces or hashes for inline scripts.

title: SSH password authentication enabled
description: SSH server accepts password-based authentication, enabling credential brute-force and password spraying.
risks: Credential stuffing using discovered email addresses (ahmed, achiboub, ahmedc) could yield shell access.
attack_vectors: Brute-force or password spray SSH using discovered usernames. Combine with email addresses from recon.
proof_of_existence: SSH negotiation confirms password authentication method is accepted by server...
remediation: Disable PasswordAuthentication in sshd_config; require key-based auth only.

title: .git directory present in web root (403 Forbidden)
description: /.git/ returns 403 — directory exists but access blocked by nginx. Bypass via encoded paths untested.
risks: Source code disclosure if bypass succeeds. Could expose credentials, API keys, application logic.
attack_vectors: Try encoded paths: /..%2f.git/HEAD, /.git/logs/HEAD, /.git/index, /%2e%2e/%2e%67it/HEAD
proof_of_existence: HTTP 403 on /.git/ — directory exists but is blocked. Encoded path bypasses not yet tested...
remediation: Remove .git directory from web root entirely; block via nginx location directive.

title: SSH accepts weak hmac-sha1 MAC algorithm
description: SSH server accepts hmac-sha1 MAC algorithm which has known weaknesses.
risks: Potential MAC forgery in MITM scenarios.
attack_vectors: MITM position required; forge SSH packet MACs using SHA-1 collision weaknesses.
proof_of_existence: SSH algorithm negotiation reveals hmac-sha1 in accepted MAC list...
remediation: Remove hmac-sha1 from MACs in sshd_config; use hmac-sha2-256/512 only.

title: nginx version disclosure via server_tokens
description: nginx version 1.24.0 disclosed in HTTP Server header.
risks: Aids attacker reconnaissance and CVE targeting.
attack_vectors: Use version to search for applicable nginx CVEs and targeted exploits.
proof_of_existence: Server: nginx/1.24.0 in HTTP response headers...
remediation: Set server_tokens off in nginx.conf.

title: Deprecated X-XSS-Protection header present
description: X-XSS-Protection header is deprecated and may introduce vulnerabilities in modern browsers.
risks: Minimal — header ignored by modern browsers but signals outdated security configuration.
attack_vectors: No direct exploitation; informational finding.
proof_of_existence: X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block in response headers...
remediation: Remove X-XSS-Protection header; rely on CSP for XSS mitigation.

title: Email addresses discovered for potential credential attacks
description: Email addresses found: ahmed, achiboub, ahmedc — likely team members associated with target.
risks: Username enumeration for SSH password spraying (password auth enabled) and phishing campaigns.
attack_vectors: Use as SSH usernames for password spray (password auth confirmed enabled). Use for targeted phishing.
poc: Recon phase discovered email addresses via web content analysis
proof_of_existence: Email addresses discovered: ahmed@cyberian-defenses.com, achiboub@..., ahmedc@... (from lisa recon)...
remediation: Limit publicly exposed email addresses; enforce strong password policies and MFA.
